versions.description: Playtime Ranks: promotes players up a ladder of Takaro roles by total playtime (e.g. Newbie 0 h, Regular 10 h, Veteran 50 h, Legend 200 h). Each rank can grant a role (so ranks unlock permissions like more teleports), pay a one-time currency reward, send a PM and broadcast. A cron job checks online players; players use 'rank' and 'ranks', admins use 'rankcheck <player>'. Roles are never taken away for a higher rank than the player earned.

commands.name: rank
commands.description: Show your playtime rank and the time to the next rank
commands.helpText: Shows your current playtime rank, your hours played and how long until the next rank.

commands.name: ranks
commands.helpText: Lists every playtime rank with the hours needed and its reward.

commands.name: rankcheck
commands.description: Admin: check and apply a player's playtime rank
commands.helpText: Admin command. Shows a player's playtime and rank, and promotes them now if they are due.

cronJobs.name: check-ranks
cronJobs.description: Checks online players' playtime and promotes them to the rank they earned.
